question: What was the first domain name ever registered in the World Wide Web?
solution:
The correct answer is __**www.symbolics.com.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The first domain name registered was **Symbolics.com**.
 
• It was registered **March 15, 1985.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• A domain name is a label that identifies a network domain: a distinct group of computers under a central administration or authority.
 
• The company managing the reservation of domain names is the domain name registrar.
 
• A domain name registry is a database of all domain names and the associated registrant information in the top-level domains of the Domain Name System (DNS)
